matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the placement of the BC term inside the indicator function in Equation 1 of the main method, creating a logical inconsistency with the warm-up period. Neither finding addresses this equation or the BC term; both findings focus on surrogate gradient mathematics in the supplementary materials (Section 8.1).

GT2 concerns the undefined derivative r′_{t−i} in Equation 7 of the adaptive slope scheduler. Neither finding addresses this equation or the slope scheduler; both findings focus on surrogate gradient definitions and properties in Section 8.1 of the supplementary materials.

GT3 concerns the soft-reset mechanism in Equation 4, specifically the inconsistency between the mathematical formulation (subtraction vs. factorization of the threshold term) and its physical interpretation. Neither finding addresses the soft-reset mechanism or Equation 4; both focus on surrogate gradient mathematics in Section 8.1.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Identifies a mathematical error in the surrogate gradient derivative formula in Section 8.1, which is not among the ground truth defects.
Identifies an inconsistency between the appendix claim about gradient bias direction and the main text/Figure 1b, which is not among the ground truth defects.
